retired_superseded_approach: operator_run_now_override_v1 special run-now gate relaxation reverted and deleted; Run Now gate bypass FALSE by design
commit_message: feat: realign daily app around continuous newsroom intelligence

continuous_ingestion.integration: housekeeping lane inside canonical ContentOpsDailyAppSupervisor.tick; zero LLM calls; adaptive 4-minute active interval with x2 idle backoff capped at 30 minutes
continuous_ingestion.capture_mechanism: bounded CDP ListLatestTweetsTimeline interception over locked CapitalChronicleBot profile (x_list_ingest_capture_v1)
continuous_ingestion.daily_headline_file_count_policy: one file per day; no timestamp-per-capture files; no parallel ALL_DATA truth; legacy files read-only history
continuous_ingestion.dedupe_proof: three-iteration focused test (append 2, re-add 2+1 new, re-add 1+1 new -> exactly 4 unique rows, one daily file) + shadow universe reconstruction (709 headlines, 15 files, 0 duplicates)
continuous_ingestion.restart_dedupe_proof: focused test reopens store; checkpoint durable; duplicate rows not rewritten

capital_chronicle_data_estate.database_type: duckdb local stores under data/local_db (read-only connections only)
capital_chronicle_data_estate.authority_dqr_freshness_semantics: preserved via governed surfaces (publication evidence packet / newsroom candidate pool / DQR fields); catalog records compact schema/profile metadata only; no raw dump

cc_read_only_connection: duckdb connect(read_only=True); catalog module refuses non-SELECT/CTE SQL by policy
story_scoped_cc_query_proof: focused test builds a fixture CC estate, runs discover + story-scoped query: Federal Reserve match found, richness > 0, zero upstream mutation; production catalog READY with 12 stores

published_corpus.related_prior_article_lookup: entity-overlap index over corpus (empty corpus honestly reported)

editorial_portfolio_policy.concentration_policy: same-entity daily soft cap 2 + deterministic concentration penalty proven by focused test

breaking_new_story_test: PASS (no corpus overlap -> BREAKING_NEW_STORY, mode BREAKING_BRIEF)
material_follow_up_test: PASS (same update chain + delta signals -> MATERIAL_FOLLOW_UP, mode FOLLOW_UP_UPDATE)
deepen_existing_story_test: PASS (older related coverage + CC richness 0.8 -> DEEPEN_EXISTING_STORY)
run_now_canonical_path: Run Now consumes the durable OPERATOR_REQUESTED trigger through the SAME canonical cycle boundary; bounded fallback intake sync only when continuous lane is stale
shadow_e2e_result: isolated SHADOW_ONLY tick: forced-free window executed full canonical cycle over reconstructed 709-headline rolling universe; assignment SELECT_STORY; viability ALL_RANKED_CLUSTERS_EVIDENCE_BLOCKED -> NO_PUBLICATION (canonical gates intact; no bypass); intake lane checkpoints durable across ticks
smoke_tests: shadow tick intake lane proof (not_due checkpoint semantics, RUNNING state, zero LLM calls) + full shadow canonical cycle E2E + production one-click restart on corrected source
caveats: production publication remains legitimately NO_PUBLICATION when canonical evidence gates block (e.g., stale governed CC packet / official-source freshness); the realignment removes DATA STARVATION as the routine blocker but never lowers truth
headline sidecar daily files are local runtime data and remain untracked in Git; historical files stay read-only
CC catalog probes up to 12 duckdb stores read-only at each portfolio-context build; costs a few seconds per cycle
no full-suite run and no CI PASS claimed
exact_next_product_blocker: fresh governed Capital Chronicle publication material and/or official-primary evidence satisfying story-type requirements so the continuously-current rolling universe converts into publishable packages; then FDA-G genuine 5-8 day calendar-time evidence
